description: This source file implements IP address handling functions and classes, including parsing, validation, and conversion between IPv4 and IPv6 formats, with specific focus on routability and prefix checks.

classes.name: IPAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with methods for validation, conversion, and string representation.

classes.name: IPAddressBytes
classes.description: Encapsulates the byte array of an IP address, providing comparison and memory estimation functions.

methods.name: IPAddress::FromValue
methods.description: Creates an IPAddress object from a base::Value if it contains a valid IP literal string.

methods.name: IPAddress::FromIPLiteral
methods.description: Parses a string literal into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: IPAddress::AssignFromIPLiteral
methods.description: Assigns the IP address from a string literal, returning success status.

methods.name: IPAddress::ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the IP address.

methods.name: IPAddress::IsPubliclyRoutable
methods.description: Checks if the IP address is publicly routable based on IPv4 or IPv6 rules.

methods.name: IPAddress::IsLoopback
methods.description: Checks if the IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: IPAddress::IsLinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if the IP address is link-local.
